class.name: HTMLSlotElement
class.brief_description: A placeholder for a shadow host's content.
class.description: Named assignment matches the host's direct children to the first slot with the same name. Unassigned slots render their fallback children. The slotchange DOM event reports changes in assignment.

method.name: assigned_nodes
method.description: Returns assigned nodes, optionally flattening nested slots and fallback content.

method.name: assigned_elements
method.description: Returns the element subset of assigned_nodes.

method.name: assign
method.description: Sets manual assignments in a shadow root configured for manual assignment. Does not move the nodes.

members.member: The slot name. An empty name denotes the default slot.
